treks.name: Everest Base Camp
treks.lede: The classic walk to the foot of the Khumbu Icefall, with two acclimatisation days built in and a sunrise climb to Kala Patthar.
permits: Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality permit

itin.x: Airport pickup, trek briefing and gear check. We collect your permits while you rest.

itin.t: Fly to Lukla, walk to Phakding
itin.x: A 35-minute mountain flight to Tenzing–Hillary Airport, then an easy downhill walk along the Dudh Koshi.
Cross the Hillary suspension bridge and climb into the Sherpa capital. First glimpse of Everest on a clear day.
Climb to the Everest View Hotel at 3,880 m for the panorama, then return to sleep low.
A contouring trail with Ama Dablam ahead, down to the river and up through rhododendron forest to the monastery.
Above the treeline through Pangboche into the Imja valley and its stone-walled fields.
Hike up Nangkartshang to 5,083 m for views of Makalu and Island Peak, then back down.
Over the Thukla pass and its climbers’ memorials, then along the Khumbu Glacier moraine.

itin.t: Gorak Shep and Everest Base Camp
itin.x: Drop bags at Gorak Shep and walk the glacier edge to Base Camp. Sleep at 5,164 m.
Pre-dawn climb to the trek’s high point for sunrise on Everest, then a long descent to thicker air.
Back through Pangboche to the monastery for evening prayers.
An easy day with time for the Sherpa museum and a bakery stop.
The last day on the trail and a farewell dinner with the crew.
Morning flight. Weather can delay Lukla flights, so keep a spare day before your flight home.

highlights: Sunrise on Everest from Kala Patthar, 5,545 m
Namche Bazaar market and Sherpa museum

treks.name: Gokyo Lakes & Gokyo Ri
treks.lede: A quieter way into the Everest region: turquoise glacial lakes beside the Ngozumpa Glacier and four 8,000 m peaks from Gokyo Ri.
permits: Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality permit

itin.x: Airport pickup, briefing and gear check.

itin.t: Fly to Lukla, walk to Phakding
itin.x: Mountain flight and a gentle first afternoon by the river.
Into Sagarmatha National Park and up the Namche hill.
Morning hike to the Everest View Hotel and back.
A short day to the Sherpa village of Khumjung and its school founded by Edmund Hillary.
Over the Mong La ridge and down into the Dudh Koshi’s upper valley.
Yak pastures and summer settlements on the west bank of the valley.
A climb on the ridge above the village for Cho Oyu views, then a free afternoon.
Past the first and second lakes to the village on the shore of Dudh Pokhari.
Pre-dawn climb for sunrise over Everest, Lhotse, Makalu and Cho Oyu. Afternoon by the lakes.
Descend the valley the way you came.
Back over Mong La to Namche.
Last day on the trail.
Morning flight back to Kathmandu.
Held in case weather delays the Lukla flight. Otherwise a free day in Kathmandu.

highlights: The Ngozumpa, longest glacier in Nepal
Fewer crowds than the Base Camp trail

treks.name: Annapurna Circuit
treks.lede: Up the Marsyangdi into the high desert of Manang, over the 5,416 m Thorong La and down to the temples of Muktinath.

itin.x: Airport pickup, briefing and gear check.
West along the Trishuli and Marsyangdi rivers to the trailhead town.
Up the Marsyangdi gorge by jeep to the district headquarters, under Annapurna II.
Past the curved rock wall of Paungda Danda into pine forest and the upper valley.
The high route via Ghyaru, with Annapurna II and III filling the southern sky.
Down through Braga monastery to Manang, the circuit’s main acclimatisation town.
Climb toward Ice Lake at 4,600 m above the Gangapurna glacier, then return.
Through Yak Kharka into the narrowing Thorong valley to the last lodges before the pass.
Start before dawn. Cross the pass, then a long knee-testing descent to Muktinath’s temples.
Down to the medieval village of Kagbeni and along the windy Kali Gandaki to Jomsom.
A 20-minute flight between Annapurna and Dhaulagiri. Afternoon by Phewa Lake.
Flight or tourist bus back to Kathmandu.

highlights: Muktinath, sacred to Hindus and Buddhists

treks.name: Langtang Valley
treks.lede: The closest big Himalayan valley to Kathmandu. Tamang villages, yak cheese at Kyanjin Gompa and a summit day on Tserko Ri.

itin.x: Airport pickup, briefing and gear check.
North past Trishuli to the trailhead on the Bhote Koshi.
Into the Langtang Khola gorge through oak and bamboo forest.
The valley opens past Ghodatabela. Langtang Village was rebuilt after the 2015 earthquake.
A short climb to the monastery and the cheese factory, under Langtang Lirung.
The trek’s summit day: a long climb for a 360° view of Langtang Lirung and the Tibetan border peaks.
Back down the valley the way you came.
Last day on the trail. Hot springs nearby at Tatopani.
Return drive to Kathmandu.
Transfer to the airport.

highlights: Kyanjin Gompa and its yak cheese

treks.name: Manaslu Circuit
treks.lede: A full circuit of the world’s eighth-highest mountain, from the Budhi Gandaki gorge to Tibetan villages and over the Larkya La.

itin.x: Airport pickup and briefing.
Restricted-area permits are issued in person. Free time in Patan or Bhaktapur.
Via Arughat to the start of the Budhi Gandaki trail.
Along the river through sal forest and terraced fields.
Past the hot springs at Tatopani to the restricted-area checkpoint.
Through Philim and the narrowing gorge, crossing the river several times.
Into Nubri, where mani walls and Tibetan Buddhist villages begin.
First full view of Manaslu above Ribung Gompa.
A short day to a village with views of Himalchuli and Ngadi Chuli.
The main village of the upper valley, with time to explore the gompa.
Hike to Pungyen Gompa beneath the Manaslu Glacier, or toward Manaslu Base Camp.
The last village before the pass, a few hours from the Tibetan border.
A short, steady climb to the stone lodge at Larkya Phedi.
The crux: up the moraine to the 5,160 m pass, then a steep descent to the meadows of Bimthang.
Down through rhododendron forest into the Dudh Khola valley.
Join the Annapurna Circuit at Dharapani and drive out down the Marsyangdi.
Back to Kathmandu.
Transfer to the airport.

highlights: Pungyen Gompa under the Manaslu Glacier
Far fewer trekkers than Everest or Annapurna

Breakfast, lunch and dinner on the trek

All trekking permits for the route
Pre-trek briefing and gear check in Kathmandu
